messages:
maria: Quick note — scheduling a dry-run pool flip tonight 01:00 PT for dedicated pool 'zephyr'. Purpose: validate autoscale policy switch (latency-target -> cost-target) and exercise rollback. Owner: @sam. Window: 01:00-01:30 PT. No production traffic routed, just canary tag. Steps below and smoke expectations.

sam: I can own the run. I'll start the canary flip and the smoke runner. cc @jeff for infra checks and rollback assist.

deploy-bot: scheduled job created: job_id=job-2026-03-17-zz, execute_at=3101235600 (01:00 PT). Notifying participants.

jeff: Can you paste the exact config diff and the commands you'll run? Also what metrics should we watch during the dry run (p95, queue length, token/sec?)

maria: Sure — minimal diff (will be applied to pool config 'zephyr'):
```yaml
# before
autoscale_policy:
  mode: latency_target
  p95_target_ms: 300
# after
autoscale_policy:
  mode: cost_target
  max_utilization: 0.75
  cost_weight: 0.6
```
CLI to apply to the canary slice:
```bash
redwoodctl pools apply --pool zephyr --slice canary --file /tmp/zephyr-policy.yaml
```
Rollback is: `redwoodctl pools rollback --pool zephyr --slice canary --to-tag stable`

linda: What's our abort criteria? If we see regressions in p95 or error rate, how many minutes before we trigger rollback?

sam: Proposed abort triggers:
- p95 latency > baseline_p95 * 1.3 for > 3 consecutive 1-min buckets
- error rate spike > 0.5% absolute for 2 consecutive minutes
- queue depth > 200 for > 2 minutes
If any trigger fires: manual rollback within 5 minutes (jeff to assist).

sam: Smoke plan (quick):
1) Run 50 concurrent short prompts (50 reqs, prompt length ~20 tokens) for 3 min
2) Tail logs: `kubectl logs -l slice=canary -n zephyr -f --since=5m`
3) Metrics to watch: `inference.p95_latency`, `inference.errors`, `queue.depth`, `gpu.utilization`
One-liner smoke load (from perf box):
```bash
hey -n 3000 -c 50 -m POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -D prompt.json https://canary.zephyr.redwood/v1/generate
```

jeff: Two small asks: please disable auto-eviction for this slice during the dry-run, and ensure the autoscaler controller logs are at DEBUG so we can see decision reasoning. I'll be on standby to run the rollback command if the abort criteria are met.

maria: done — auto-eviction toggled off for canary and controller loglevel set to DEBUG. Pushed policy file to /tmp/zephyr-policy.yaml on perf box.

sam: I'll kick it off at 01:00 PT and post timestamps/results here. If everything looks good at 01:10 PT (no triggers), we'll mark the dry-run as success and schedule a wider rollforward for the next maintenance window. If not, jeff performs rollback and confirms. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled in 45m. job_id=job-2026-03-17-zz

linda: Thanks — tagging QA to glance at generated outputs during the canary: @qa-team.

maria: Appreciate it. Any last-minute concerns? If not, we proceed as planned.

sam: All set from my side. Will update here as I go.

linda: Thanks everyone — will monitor dashboards and be ready to escalate.
